name: ms-corporate-income-tax
description: Montserrat corporate income tax reference checked for 2026 against the official Income and Corporation Tax Act consolidation. Covers the standard company rate, the distinction between accounting profit and chargeable income, selected expense restrictions, annual return requirements and instalment payments. Includes an illustrative tax reconciliation and a separate prior-assessment instalment example. Use after company residence, taxable scope and the relevant accounting period have been established. Identifies remitted branch profits as a separate withholding issue. Incentives, capital allowances, losses, treaty relief and later legislative changes require further review. This source-cited draft is not accountant-attested.
